# Commercial catalog states

| Theme | Access | Code state | Release condition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Vila das Criaturas | Starter | Internal preview, selectable | Provenance + Brazilian IP opinion + final-brand clearance |
| Estúdio em Caos | Premium | Catalog only, unsellable | Original art/copy/audio + rights record + store review assets |
| Órbita de Sabotagem | Premium | Catalog only, unsellable | Original art/copy/audio + rights record + store review assets |
| Folclore BR | Premium candidate | Blocked | Cultural/editorial/legal review |
| Rio Sátira | Not scheduled | Blocked | Political/editorial/legal review |

Only `status: published` plus an approved `ThemeRightsRecord` may enter a commercial build. Guests receive a derived theme ID/media/ad policy for the room, never the host's entitlement rows.
